name: yolo-vsc
description: Launch AI CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, CodeBuddy, Goose, …) in an embedded terminal with clickable file/type links.

yolo.agents.description: User overrides / additions merged on top of the built-in catalog in agents.json. Override a built-in by matching its `command` (only the fields you set replace it, including `yoloArgs` and `resumeFlag`); set `enabled: false` to hide a built-in; use a `command` not in agents.json to add a custom agent. Reload the window after editing.

command.description: CLI binary launched in the terminal (also used for PATH detection). Required.

displayName.description: Name shown in the panel. Defaults to `command` for custom agents.

baseArgs.description: Arguments passed before the agent's subcommand.

yoloArgs.description: Extra args appended when YOLO (skip-permissions) mode is on.

resumeFlag.description: Flag appended when Resume mode is on (e.g. `--resume`) to continue the most recent session.

iconFile.description: Icon filename under the extension's media/agents folder (e.g. claude.png). If omitted, a default terminal icon is used.

enabled.description: Set to false to hide an agent without deleting its entry.

yolo.skipEnabled.description: Inject the skip-permission flag when launching an agent.

yolo.resumeMode.description: Append the agent's resume flag (e.g. --resume) to continue the most recent session.

yolo.agentBaseArgs.description: Extra launch args per promoted agent id (lower-cased).

yolo.installedCommands.description: Cache of commands detected as installed on this machine.

yolo.shell.description: Override the shell used to launch agents and probe PATH. Absolute path or a binary name on PATH. On Windows, leaving this empty auto-detects a POSIX shell (Git Bash / WSL) when needed; otherwise cmd.exe is used.

yolo.shellArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the shell before the agent command (e.g. ["-l"]). Ignored on Windows cmd.exe.

scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:webview
